component.name: dlss5-linux
component.summary: DLSS 5 neural rendering for games running under Proton

description.p: Picks the injection route that fits a game running under Proton, installs it, writes the Proton launch configuration, and reads the logs back to say whether it worked.

Five routes. Four put something in the game folder - OptiScaler as a proxy DLL, or ReShade with the feeder, native or bridge add-ons. The fifth is a Linux Vulkan layer that runs the model beside the game and reaches what the others cannot: native Vulkan titles, and D3D12 games without DLSS.
Nothing is bundled. Every component is fetched from its own publisher at run time, and an install records what it wrote so it can be taken back out.
